messages:
julia_k: Quick postmortem follow-up for the KV eviction incident. Need owners + deadlines to convert learnings into: regression tests, an eval promptset, a weekly canary, a short load spike, and a monthly chaos drill. Fast comments pls.

omar: I can own the deterministic regression tests. Plan: small suite in tests/eviction_patterns/ with replayable traces + exact expected outputs for deterministic flows. PR by 05/10.

samir: I'll curate the eval promptset (EVAL-900) to cover repeated-token loops, long-prefix chains, and streaming truncation. Will attach golden outputs (strict + fuzzy) and token/sequence metrics. PR + initial run by 05/08.

qa-ryan: I'll take CI gating. Add a `eviction-regress` job that runs on PR and nightly; block merges when it fails. Need Omar's test filenames and Samir's golden outputs to set thresholds. ETA to have gating wired: 05/15.

ops-izzy: I'll own the canary + short load spike. Weekly canary idea: lightweight job Mon 02:00 UTC that runs a 10m synthetic burst against staging (warm keys + mixed prefixes); create alert if fail 2x in a row. First canary wired by 05/12. Also plan a 20m k6 spike at 2x for the load test on 05/18.

julia_k: Monthly chaos drill proposal: run in staging the third Tuesday of each month; k6 spike + random single-worker reboot mid-spike. Ops please confirm the hour window.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-1999: "eviction -> tests + canary + chaos" assigned to omar.

omar: I'll include a simple local replay command in the README: `python tools/replay.py traces/eviction_weekend_burst.json` and pytest quick-run: `pytest tests/eviction_patterns -k reproducer -q`.

samir: For eval goldens I'll provide both exact-match files and fuzzy thresholds. Adding a `kv_miss_regression` metric emitted by the eval harness.

qa-ryan: On gating I'll: 1) block merges if `eviction-regress` fails; 2) mark flakiness if pass rate < 90% over last 7 runs; 3) auto-open TASK-PLAT subtasks if canary fails repeatedly.

ops-izzy: Canary snippet for infra: `k6 run --vus 60 --duration 10m scripts/canary_eviction.js` (uses warm keys). I'll add alert hooks to page oncall.

julia_k: Owner recap for PM-FU-6000: omar -> regression tests (TASK-PLAT-1999), samir -> eval promptset EVAL-900, ops-izzy -> weekly canary + load (TASK-OPS-777), qa-ryan -> CI gating. Please add PR links to PM-FU-6000 when opened. Weekly check-ins until closed.

qa-ryan: I'll watch the first two canary runs for noise and loop infra if we hit resource constraints.

samir: Also request that we add a lightweight deploy smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warm_key_check"}'` to pre-deploy checks.

julia_k: Great. I'll file PM-FU-6000 and schedule the first check-in. Closing thread unless blockers. :thumbsup:
